question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: To show the cold shoulder
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"To show the cold shoulder"** means to deliberately ignore someone or give them an unfriendly reception. (जानबूझकर किसी को नजरअंदाज करना) • **Example:** Despite his repeated apologies, she showed him the cold shoulder and refused to talk to him. • The phrase conveys a sense of intentional neglect or disinterest in someone’s presence or actions. (जानबूझकर किसी के प्रति उदासीनता दिखाना) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: To behave proudly** (घमंड से व्यवहार करना): Acting in a way that demonstrates arrogance or excessive pride. • **Example:** He started behaving proudly after receiving the award, which alienated his friends. • **Option 3: To pretend friendship** (दोस्ती का नाटक करना): To act as if you are someone's friend but not genuinely mean it. • **Example:** She pretended friendship with her colleagues only to gather information. • **Option 4: To feel embarrassed** (शर्मिंदा महसूस करना): Feeling awkward or ashamed about something. • **Example:** He felt embarrassed when his mistake was pointed out in front of everyone. 37:T603, The correct answer is** option 1.**
